title: RBI Penalty Orders on Bank of Baroda and GIC Housing Finance
description: <cite index="28-3,28-4,28-5">RBI imposed a total penalty of Rs 66.7 lakh on Bank of Baroda and GIC Housing Finance for regulatory compliance violations. Bank of Baroda was fined Rs 63.6 lakh for non-compliance with Fair Practices Code for Lenders and KYC guidelines</cite>.
